description.narrative: Effective SHS system established and implemented

Proportion of SHS students in non-DepEd SHSs increases from zero (2014) to 40%, by 2019 (DLI) Achievement: 40 Progress/Status: Achieved. In 2018, at least 40% of SHS enrolments are in non-DepEd schools. This was achieved in advance (DLI5). Data Source: EBEIS

Cohort survival rate for secondary level (for grades 7-12) improves from 78.8% (for grades 7-10) in 2010 to 90% (for grades 7-12), by 2019 (90% for girls and 89% for boys) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Pending, to be determined. While DepEd has been collecting and computing sex-disaggregated data to come up with the cohort survival rate since 2003, based on discussions with the TWG on Education Statistics of the government, DepEd is currently refining the formula used for the Cohort Survival Rate (and Completion Rate) using the reconstructed cohort so this will serve as the new baseline. Data Source: EBEIS Base year: 2015 Baseline value: N

Learning outcomes in mathematics and science, as measured by MPS on national achievement test, improve from 46.8% (2013) to 50% in mathematics (MPS of at least 45% for males and for females) and from 41.3% (2013) to 45% in science (MPS of at least 40% for males and for females), by 2019 (DLI) Achievement: N Progress/Status: Partially achieved. Since the National Achievement Test (NAT) for School Year (SY) 2019-2020 and SY 2020-2021 were not administered due to COVID-19 safety restrictions, and given that the NAT for SY 2021-2022 will only be administered from April to June 2022, the test results will only be determined in the third or fourth quarter of 2022, beyond the project's closing date. Hence, the government decided to use the last Grade 12 NAT results administered in February 2019. Based on the DLI verification protocol, the DLI targets were only partially achieved. Data Source: EBEIS Base year: 2015 Baseline value: N

SHS GER in SY2021-2022 is at least 2 percentage points higher than the SY2020-2021 baseline. Progress/Status: Achieved as of December 2021. Based on the official data provided, SHS Gross Enrolment Rate increased to 90.6% in SY 2021-2022, from 79.2% in the previous school year, or an 11.4 percentage increase from the SY 2020-2021 baseline. Data Source: EBEIS Base year: 2021 Baseline value: N

Technical and vocational skills certification rate reaches at least 50% (at least 45% for males and 50% for females), by 2019 (DLI) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. DepEd, with ADB support, developed a data collection protocol on this indicator, which was integrated in the DepEd's EBEIS data collection forms. The public school TVL exit assessment passing rates for SY 2018/2019 are 94.55% for males and 96.21% for females. Data Source: EBEIS Base year: 2015 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

More than 5.9 million students were enrolled and completed SHS since 2016. In SY 2018-2019 alone, 3,021,856 students enrolled in DepEd and non-DepEd SHSs (47% of total are enrolled in non-DepEd SHS; 52% of total are females) Data Source: EBEIS

Output: Results Area 1: Quality of DepEd SHS program improved Indicator: 1b (ii). At least 50% of DepEd SHSs have sufficient numbers of qualified science teachers, as specified in DepEd teacher-student ratio MSS by 2019 (2012 baseline: 21% for science) Achievement: 93 Progress/Status: Achieved. As of March 2018, 95% of SHSs achieved MSS for specialized mathematics teachers; 93% of SHSs achieved MSS for specialized science teachers In SY 2018-2019, DepEd Q&A data on total number of teachers by teaching assignment in public SHS showed that majority of mathematics and science teachers are females. DepEd SHS mathematics teachers totaled 38,686, 56.2% of whom are females while DepEd SHS science teachers totaled 58,387 with 64.5% accounted for by females. Data Source: EBEIS

Output: Results Area 2: Minimum service standard for school facilities in DepEd SHSs achieved Indicator: 100% of SHSs have separate male and female toilets (SY2010/11 baseline: 48.4% of toilets at JHS level were shared by boys and girls) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: Achieved. DepEd has released DepEd Order No. 64, s. 2017 entitled Minimum Performance and Standard Specifications for School Buildings. This DepEd Order contains specific provision for the inclusion of male and female toilets in the design of school buildings. http://www.deped.gov.ph/sites/default/files/order/2017/DO_s2017_064.pdf All newly constructed SHS buildings have separate toilet for males and females. Data Source: Approved design plan includes gendered design elements

As of March 2018, 95% of SHSs achieved MSS for specialized mathematics teachers; 93% of SHSs achieved MSS for specialized science teachers In SY 2018-2019, DepEd Q&A data on total number of teachers by teaching assignment in public SHS showed that majority of mathematics and science teachers are females. DepEd SHS mathematics teachers totaled 38,686, 56.2% of whom are females while DepEd SHS science teachers totaled 58,387 with 64.5% accounted for by females. Data Source: EBEIS

Output: Results Area 1: Quality of DepEd SHS program improved Indicator: 1a. Approved SHS curriculum implemented in all SHSs by 2016 Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. DepEd SHS curriculum that includes specific learning outcomes for mathematics and science in the core subjects and all 4 tracks, as applicable, promulgated in 2014. Posted on DepEd website (http://www.deped.gov.ph/k-to-12/About/curriculum-guides).
Through DepEd Order No. 32, s. 2017 Gender-responsive Basic Education Policy, guidelines have been established to ensure that DepEd integrates the principles of gender equality, gender equity, gender sensitivity, non-discrimination, and human rights in the provision and governance of basic education. Focus has been in strengthening the Gender and Development (GAD) component in the school curricula, with GAD concerns seamlessly and appropriately integrated across the grade levels and across subjects.
Data Source: DepEd order on SHS curriculum Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
